title: Lucas County EMA: State Reporting Request

transcript.speaker: Lucas County EMA
transcript.text: Lucas County EMA. The Ohio Department of Health has requested a status update on all hospitals receiving trauma patients from the multi-vehicle crash on the interstate. Please provide: number of patients received, critical count, beds open, diversion status, and what resources you need overnight. Also, confirm whether you can accept the second-wave patients still at the scene.

transcript.speaker: AOC
transcript.text: This is the Administrator on Call at Ottawa River Regional Medical Center. We have received 36 crash patients. Of those, 11 are critical. We are at 351 patients, census 351, with 11 ICU beds and 3 PACU overflow beds open. We are on Surge Level C and will not divert any further. We need 4 ICU transfers out, 6 ventilators, 10 units of O-negative blood, and 12 additional nurses for overnight coverage.

transcript.speaker: Lucas County EMA
transcript.text: Understood. We will report your status to the state. We will also coordinate with your regional coalition for the transfers. Thank you for the update.

instructorNote: This inject tests the AOC’s ability to report accurate, complete, and responsible status to external agencies. Watch for overpromising capacity or underreporting critical needs.
